Set the starting population of a Hammel model

Source: R/hammel_model.R
set_population.Rd

Supply a validated population containing person and union histories and their reference time. Tables are normalized to tibbles; column contents and additional components are retained. Existing process configuration is retained. The input model is not modified. Grouped populations without ancestry proportions initialize each starting person at 100% ancestry in their recorded group. Supplied ancestry is retained and normalized to a tibble in person order; see hammel_population().

Usage

set_population(model, population)

Arguments

model

A hammel_model object.

population

A hammel_population object. Construct it from tables with hammel_population(). Its end_time supplies the model's starting time.

Value

An updated hammel_model.

Examples

persons <- data.frame(person_id = 1:2, sex = c("m", "f"),
  birth_time = c(-25, -23), death_time = NA_real_,
  mother_id = NA_integer_, father_id = NA_integer_)
population <- hammel_population(persons, end_time = 0)
model <- hammel_model() |>
  set_population(population)
